about_the_game:
Ironsphere is a top-down, tactical shooter where every battle tests your skill, strategy, and mech customization.

🤖 PILOT POWERFUL MECHS

Choose from over 20 unique mechs with different speed, armor, energy, and load capacities. Each mech can be fully customized with weapons, armor, modules, and tactical equipment.

⚔️ STRATEGIC COMBAT

Balance firepower, mobility, and energy to dominate giant insects, hostile machines, and automated defenses. Use turrets, mines, shields, and other gadgets to survive.

🌌 A DANGEROUS WORLD

Altair b 8 Octavus is an extreme environment with radiation, temperature swings, and ruthless corporate wars. Every mission is a fight for survival and control over valuable resources.

🎮 CUSTOMIZE & CONQUER

Optimize your loadout for speed, firepower, or endurance. Master each mech and adapt to every deadly encounter.

Battle for survival, control resources, and prove your supremacy in the ultimate mech shooter.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS *: Windows® 7 (SP1) / Windows® 8 / Windows® 10 64-bit/ Windows® 11
  • Processor: Quad-core processor
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: D3D11-compatible graphics card
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS *: Windows® 7 (SP1) / Windows® 8 / Windows® 10 64-bit/ Windows® 11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or Ryzen 5 3600 and above
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Nvidia GeForce 1060 or Radeon RX 570 and above
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

short_description: Ironsphere is a fast-paced top-down mech shooter set on a hostile moon. Fight giant insects and deadly machines, pilot 20+ customizable mechs, and balance speed, armor, and energy. Equip weapons, shields, and modules to survive brutal battles and claim victory.
